text: With the ledger live, Theo Branagh builds Accounts Payable for Arjun Mehta's team -- purchase-order invoices and standalone invoices both.

PO-matched invoices go through three-way match against the purchase order and its receipt. Standalone invoices -- freight bills, utility bills -- get keyed directly, with no purchase order behind them.
The Subledger Accounting rule sources the Cost Center from the purchase order's Requesting Business Unit when one exists, and defaults to Corporate, Cost Center 100, when it doesn't.
Testing covers PO-matched invoices from all three warehouses, plus standalone bills checked for the right dollar amount -- and Arjun signs off on both.
Next: Accounts Receivable and Cash Management -- customer credit limits, collections, and bank reconciliation.
